summary: Iteration 19 — Frontend-only regression pass after (1) classic SOLID nav icons and (2) app-wide teal/emerald → sky-blue theme swap. Flow: calc-vault (1,1,+,3,7,=) → welcome → login (mei@demo.com / Demo1234!) → tabs. All 5 bottom tabs render with the new SOLID single-fill glyphs from src/ui/NavIcons.tsx (speech bubble / two-people / Saturn+ring / microphone / person bust) and the active tab is correctly tinted with the new brand blue (#0E9AE0). Cycled all 5 tabs (tab-chats, tab-connect, tab-moments, tab-voice, tab-profile) with zero red-screen / runtime errors, and successfully navigated to every screen listed in the review request: /edit-profile, /account-overview, /vocab-hub, /all-courses, /ai-lens, /create-group, /placement-test, /moments-report, /classes/pro-partner, /language-courses/en, /admin-x7k2p9, plus /room/<id> via the Voice tab's live room card — every route loaded and rendered. Blue theme is applied to the vast majority of primary UI (Create Room CTA, Chats + button, Voice Room card gradients, Connect filter chips, active tab tint, edit-profile Preview button, vocab-hub 'Learning English' hero, filter search chips). Only console message across the whole run was one carry-over React web warning: 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin (transformOrigin)' from react-native-svg's <G rotation origin=...> on web — non-blocking. HOWEVER: several visually prominent emerald leftovers (#10B981) remain in the primary UI that the theme swap missed — see frontend_issues.design_issues for the full list with file:line references. These are the only issues; there are no crashes, no broken screens, no auth or navigation regressions. Backend was not exercised this round per E1 instructions.

The 'Set chat background' row's leading icon tint is still hardcoded green. Ref: app/group-settings/[id].tsx:319 -> tint='#10B981'. Minor, but visibly out-of-palette next to the other blue tinted rows.

react_native_issues.issue: The <G rotation={-25} origin='12, 11.5'> prop on react-native-svg emits a React-DOM console warning on web: 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin. Did you mean transformOrigin?' — carry-over from react-native-svg's SSR/web transform mapping. Non-blocking (renders correctly), but it's the only warning we see across the whole app. Consider using transform={[{rotation:-25, originX:12, originY:11.5}]} or wrapping with a rotated <Path> instead.

action_items: Swap the remaining hardcoded #10B981 accents in PRIMARY UI to blue: app/(tabs)/profile.tsx:47 (Connect chip), app/(tabs)/chats.tsx:114 (Market chip), app/group-settings/[id].tsx:319 (chat-background icon tint).

Update the green->blue hero LinearGradients so they read as blue-only: app/edit-profile.tsx:711, app/user/[id].tsx:264, app/moments-report.tsx:83. Suggested: ['#0E9AE0','#38B6F1'] (light) or use theme brand + brandSecondary.

Optional: fix the react-native-svg 'transform-origin' web warning in src/ui/NavIcons.tsx MomentsIcon by switching from the <G rotation origin=.../> prop pattern to the transform=[{...}] array form (or move rotation onto the <Ellipse> directly). Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: src/theme.ts — light and dark palettes both have brand=#0E9AE0 / #38B6F1 and every downstream token (waveActive, brandSecondary, brandTertiary, speedPillText, bubbleMine) is consistent with the new blue. Good.

src/ui/NavIcons.tsx — glyphs are pure single-fill SVGs so the tabBar's active/inactive tint propagates uniformly through the `color` prop. Spring 'pop' (1 -> 1.08) on focus animates smoothly. The one small gotcha is the <G rotation origin=.../> in MomentsIcon which triggers a benign React DOM prop warning on web (see react_native_issues).

app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx — tabBarActiveTintColor=colors.brand and tabBarInactiveTintColor=colors.onSurfaceSecondary correctly pull from theme, so the blue tint follows the palette in both light and dark mode. All 5 tabs have `tabBarButtonTestID`.

The theme swap was mostly done by bulk-replacing the OLD emerald hexes (#059669/#047857/#14B8A6/#0D9488/#2DD4BF) — verified via grep, ZERO occurrences remain in src/ or app/. What was NOT replaced is #10B981, which is legitimately the `success` semantic color in the theme but was ALSO used ad-hoc for a handful of primary-UI accents (see action_items). Those handful of files need a manual pass.
No deprecated Expo packages detected (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch). package.json is clean on that front.
